Description - GET /chomik/chomikbox/LoginFromBox

The client opens web pages in the browser through this auto-login URL ([proto-webox] web-box-service-url, chomikuj.pl brand overlay http://%1/chomik/chomikbox/LoginFromBox?t=%2&returnUrl=/, with %1 = the service host box.chomikuj.pl and %2 = the raw Auth token). The client's first request therefore goes to http://box.chomikuj.pl/chomik/chomikbox/LoginFromBox…, which redirects once (307) to the same URL on chomikuj.pl (loginfrombox-box-host). There the service sets a web session cookie (ChomikSession) and redirects to returnUrl.

Pages opened this way (the other web-box-* templates append to this URL, so the page lands in returnUrl): web-box-info-url = /ChomikBox (generic default /Box), web-box-add-transfer-url = /DodatkowyTransfer.aspx (generic /AddTransfer.aspx), web-box-add-points-url = /DodatkowePunkty.aspx (generic /AddPoint.aspx), web-box-freedback-url (sic) = /ChomikBoxOpinia.aspx (generic /BoxOpinion.aspx), web-box-user-url = /<user>. The captures used the generic page names; only the redirect was recorded, no page was followed and nothing was bought.

Invalid token: 302 to / without ChomikSession. The client builds %1/t=invalid&returnUrl= on logout.

Client vs live - discrepancies

Where the client's expected behaviour and the live service disagree, the spec follows the live behaviour (x-discrepancies):

  • Path only: the client's generic default path is /box/LoginFromBox; live only the chomikuj.pl brand-overlay path /chomik/chomikbox/LoginFromBox works. The host is correct: the client uses the service host box.chomikuj.pl, which redirects once (307) to chomikuj.pl.

Security notes - findings that concern GET /chomik/chomikbox/LoginFromBox

  • C-01 High All client traffic uses plain HTTP (SOAP, upload, resume check, downloads, web login hand-off, updater, crash reports). The SOAP service also answers on HTTPS, but the client never uses it.
  • C-06 Medium The session token travels in clear in every SOAP body and as a URL query parameter (LoginFromBox?t=), where it becomes a full web session (ChomikSession) and can leak via logs, history and proxies.

From x-security-notes in the spec. Ratings and scope are explained on Security & privacy.
